new_title: Your Insurance Keeps Every Dollar You Don't Claim (Takaful Explained) #takaful #islamicfinance
new_description:
Every dollar you don't claim, your insurance company keeps. That's the business model.
Takaful flips it — members donate into a shared pool, claims are paid from the pool, and the surplus goes back to the members, not the company. The 1,400-year-old fix for Gharar.

Part 12 of The Money Machine, Decoded.
